blocks.text: MEMPHIS, Tennessee — Jaylen Wells had 22 points and Cedric Coward scored 19 to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to their fifth straight win in the NBA on Thursday night, 126-98 over the short-handed Golden State Warriors. Cam Boozer and Olivier Maxence-Prosper scored 16 apiece for the Grizzlies, who never trailed and led by 34 points in the fourth quarter. Javon Small added 14 points.
